# agentgateway_llm_model (Resource)

A model that clients request through agentgateway and how it maps to a provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A public model that clients request directly. The provider is one of the
# names built into agentgateway; api_key accepts an environment reference.
resource "agentgateway_llm_model" "gpt_4o" {
  name          = "gpt-4o"
  provider_name = "openai"
  model         = "gpt-4o-2024-11-20"
  display_name  = "GPT-4o"
  visibility    = "public"
  api_key       = "$OPENAI_API_KEY"

  defaults_json = jsonencode({
    temperature = 0.2
  })

  request_headers_json = jsonencode({
    set = {
      "x-tenant" = "platform"
    }
  })
}

# An internal model: clients cannot request it directly, only a virtual model
# can route to it. provider_reference points at an agentgateway_llm_provider
# entry by name, and id pins the stable identity independently of the
# client-facing match pattern.
resource "agentgateway_llm_model" "claude_sonnet" {
  name               = "claude-*"
  id                 = "claude-sonnet"
  provider_reference = "shared-anthropic"
  model              = "claude-sonnet-4-5"
  visibility         = "internal"

  guardrails_json = jsonencode({
    streaming = "Enabled"
  })

  prompt_caching_json = jsonencode({
    cacheSystem   = true
    cacheMessages = true
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Client-facing model name or wildcard match pattern.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Upstream credential (`params.apiKey`). Supports `$ENV` references and `{file: …}`.
- `auth_json` (String, Sensitive) Authentication settings for the connection to the provider (`auth`).
- `authorization_json` (String, Sensitive) Per-model HTTP authorization rules (`authorization`).
- `aws_region` (String) AWS region for `bedrock` (`params.awsRegion`).
- `azure_api_version` (String) Azure API version (`params.azureApiVersion`).
- `azure_project_name` (String) Azure Foundry project name (`params.azureProjectName`).
- `azure_resource_name` (String) Azure resource name (`params.azureResourceName`).
- `azure_resource_type` (String) Azure resource type, `openAI` or `foundry` (`params.azureResourceType`).
- `backend_tls_json` (String, Sensitive) TLS settings for the connection to the provider (`backendTLS`).
- `backend_tunnel_json` (String, Sensitive) Tunneling settings for the connection to the provider (`backendTunnel`).
- `base_url` (String) Upstream base URL (`params.baseUrl`).
- `custom_provider_json` (String, Sensitive) Custom provider as JSON, `{model, providerOverride, formats}`. Exactly one of `provider_name`, `provider_reference` or `custom_provider_json` must be set.
- `defaults_json` (String, Sensitive) Default request payload values (`defaults`).
- `display_name` (String) Label shown in the UI in place of `name`. Does not affect matching.
- `final_transformation_json` (String, Sensitive) CEL transformations applied after conversion to the provider format (`finalTransformation`).
- `guardrails_json` (String, Sensitive) Guardrails applied to requests or responses (`guardrails`).
- `health_json` (String, Sensitive) Outlier detection for this model backend (`health`).
- `host_override` (String) Upstream host override (`params.hostOverride`).
- `id` (String) Stable identity of the model entry. Defaults to `name`; changing it renames the model in place.
- `matches_json` (String, Sensitive) Extra request conditions for selecting this model (`matches`).
- `model` (String) Upstream model id (`params.model`).
- `overrides_json` (String, Sensitive) Request payload values that override the client (`overrides`).
- `passthrough_json` (String, Sensitive) Passthrough mode and detection settings (`passthrough`).
- `path_override` (String) Upstream path override (`params.pathOverride`).
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix to strip before forwarding (`params.pathPrefix`).
- `prompt_caching_json` (String, Sensitive) Cache point insertion settings (`promptCaching`).
- `provider_name` (String) Built-in or preset provider name. Exactly one of `provider_name`, `provider_reference` or `custom_provider_json` must be set.
- `provider_reference` (String) Name of an `agentgateway_llm_provider` entry to inherit from. Exactly one of `provider_name`, `provider_reference` or `custom_provider_json` must be set.
- `request_headers_json` (String, Sensitive) Header modifier applied to requests to the provider (`requestHeaders`).
- `request_transformation_json` (String, Sensitive) CEL transformations of the HTTP request to the provider (`requestTransformation`).
- `response_headers_json` (String, Sensitive) Header modifier applied to responses from the provider (`responseHeaders`).
- `tokenize` (Boolean) Ask the gateway to tokenize requests for this model (`params.tokenize`).
- `transformation_json` (String, Sensitive) CEL transformations of the LLM request payload (`transformation`).
- `vertex_project` (String) Vertex AI project (`params.vertexProject`).
- `vertex_region` (String) Vertex AI region (`params.vertexRegion`).
- `visibility` (String) Whether clients may request the model directly (`public`) or only through a virtual model (`internal`).

### Read-Only

- `revision` (Number) Server revision of the model.
